subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should ClawSweeper carry and deploy `/bay-demo` as a supported public-but-unlisted experimental dashboard surface?
rationale: Automated review can assess implementation quality, but it cannot decide whether the value of this large visualization warrants its ongoing assets, state model, and production maintenance cost.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Accept the experiment after dynamic interaction and network-boundary proof is supplied and the CodeQL result is dispositioned.

options.title: Keep the prototype external
options.body: Decline production deployment and retain only the existing operational dashboard surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the experiment after dynamic interaction and network-boundary proof is supplied and the CodeQL result is dispositioned.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most current dashboard Worker and deployment-smoke history and is the strongest available product-routing candidate.
